title: Ollama usage guard single-check status
description: The redacted machine-readable single-check status emitted by the standalone operator utility .factory/loop/usage.py (Task 7). The hidden stdlib guard retains the .factory/tools/ollama-usage-guard.sh --check/--wait exit table (0 allowed, 1 quota threshold, 2 fatal, 3 transient) and hardens the credential transport: the cookie appears in no child argv, no child environment, no log, no result, and no proc scan; every printed field is credential-token redacted; owned buffers are zeroized. reset_hint is already redacted by the fetch child before it crosses the pipe.
